missing: A direct, priced answer to "cheapest kit worth buying": the actual current bundle price (station + panel) for the entry-level kits (Jackery Explorer 300 V2 + 40W, Bluetti AC50B + PV60F, Anker C300 + panel, etc.), whether the bundled panel is too small to be useful, and a tested minimum-spend threshold below which kits are not worth it.
why: No major reviewer tests budget kits head-on, but PopSci's tested solar-generator roundup carries a named "Best budget" pick (Jackery Explorer 300), and Popular Mechanics has two tested roundups in the top ranks, so ChatGPT has credible partial answers to lean on. The rest is deal posts, panel-only tests, off-target lists, and four niche sites (powersized, RoverSolar, runtimemath) that compare on specs and prices without checkable testing—one of which admits it has no budget kit in stock. A focused page with current bundle prices, a clear price floor, and a direct cheapest-worth-buying pick could get in, but it would be competing with PopSci and Popular Mechanics rather than walking in uncontested.
